name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia launched 433 drones overnight on 1 Nov; Kyiv under emergency power cuts
state: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 433 drones overnight into 1 Nov, 371 of which were downed, with hits at 16 locations; Kyiv introduced emergency power cuts after attacks on energy infrastructure. A drone strike on Dnipro's main station on 29 Oct killed at least 13 civilians (UN). Front lines changed little.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy infrastructure may affect European power and gas markets this winter.
